medium_risk_advisory: Weather conditions have started favoring Early Blight in Potato. Improve field drainage and airflow, avoid overhead irrigation, and remove and destroy infected plant parts. Monitor daily.
high_risk_advisory: Conditions are strongly favorable for rapid spread of Early Blight in Potato. Apply a recommended fungicide as per local agricultural extension guidance without delay, isolate severely affected plants, and consult your nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra or agricultural officer.
expert_advisory: Persistent or worsening Early Blight symptoms in Potato despite treatment should be reported to a plant pathologist or agricultural extension officer for lab confirmation and updated management advice.
preventive_measures: Use certified disease-free planting material, maintain field sanitation, rotate crops where possible, and avoid dense planting to keep canopy airflow open.
organic_treatment: Neem-based sprays, Trichoderma-based bio-fungicides, and copper-based organic fungicides can help suppress early infection when used preventively.
chemical_treatment: A recommended contact or systemic fungicide (as approved by local extension services) applied at the first sign of symptoms is generally more effective than after severe spread.
